$comment: License policy for the third-party software scmCode ships. Read by
scripts/notices/generate-notices.mjs, which fails when a component falls outside it.
Rust crates are checked by cargo-deny against deny.toml; 'allowedLicenses' must stay
identical to the 'allow' list there (the generator checks this).
Changing anything here is a licensing decision: review the component first.

tools.$comment: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt must come out identical on every machine, so the tools that produce it are pinned.

allowedAssetLicenses.$comment: Licenses accepted for fonts, icons and data, not for code. Apply to npm packages, repository files and extensions.
allowedAssetLicenses.CC-BY-4.0: Codicons icon font (@vscode/codicons). Attribution is given in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and public/codicon.ttf.license.txt.

@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog.reason: The npm package ships only LICENSE.spdx. The text is LICENSE_MIT of the crate tauri-plugin-dialog 2.7.0, the same version from the same repository (tauri-apps/plugins-workspace).

@tauri-apps/plugin-shell.reason: The npm package ships only LICENSE.spdx. The text is LICENSE_MIT of the crate tauri-plugin-shell 2.3.5, the same version from the same repository (tauri-apps/plugins-workspace).

@xterm/addon-serialize.reason: Published without a LICENSE file. It is part of the xterm.js repository and covered by that repository's MIT license, which @xterm/xterm ships.

licenseNames.$comment: Values of 'license' in the cgmanifest.json files of Code - OSS extensions, reviewed and mapped to an SPDX id or a LicenseRef.

allowedLicenseRefs.LicenseRef-TextMate-Bundle: Permissive license of TextMate bundles: use, modification and distribution allowed; notice reproduced.
allowedLicenseRefs.LicenseRef-W3C-Document: W3C Document License: copying and distribution allowed with the notice; data in html-language-features.
allowedLicenseRefs.LicenseRef-W3C-Software: W3C Software Notice and License: permissive, notice reproduced.
allowedLicenseRefs.LicenseRef-Unicode-Data-Files: Unicode data files license: permissive, notice reproduced.

unlabeledComponents.$comment: Components whose cgmanifest.json entry has no 'license' value. The license was read from Code - OSS's ThirdPartyNotices.txt.

supplements.$comment: Extra notices a component's license requires and Code - OSS does not reproduce. Apache-2.0 section 4(d): Moby's NOTICE file.
